Name: PopCap Hits!
Overview:
Four Smash Hits on One Disc!

Experience the ultimate in puzzle-solving arcade action with these hit titles from PopCap, the number 1 creators of casual games. Play all four top-selling Xbox LIVE Arcade classics in one fantastic set.

Bejeweled 2
Solve the gem swapping puzzle classic!

Peggle
Catch the fever of the peg-busting phenomenon!

Feeding Frenzy
Chomp your way through 50 levels to reach the Shark King!

AstroPop
Blast off to high-speed arcade-puzzle action!
